name: ai-core/ag-ui-protocol
description: Server-side AG-UI streaming protocol implementation: StreamChunk event types (RUN_STARTED, TEXT_MESSAGE_START/CONTENT/END, TOOL_CALL_START/ARGS/END, RUN_FINISHED, RUN_ERROR, REASONING_*, STATE_SNAPSHOT/DELTA, CUSTOM), toServerSentEventsStream() for SSE format, toHttpStream() for NDJSON format. For backends serving AG-UI events without client packages.
